```{r}
merged <- SetIdent(merged, value = merged@meta.data$global.type)
```

```{r}
sender_celltypes <- "endocardium"
receiver_celltypes <- c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatic', 'adipocyte', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'mast')
```

```{r}
nichenet_function <- function(receiver) {
  expressed_genes_receiver <- get_expressed_genes(receiver, merged, pct = 0.05)
  all_receptors <- unique(lr_network$to)  
  expressed_receptors <- intersect(all_receptors, expressed_genes_receiver)

  potential_ligands <- lr_network %>% filter(to %in% expressed_receptors) %>% pull(from) %>% unique()
  
  #define a set of potential ligands for both the sender-agnostic and sender-focused approach
  # Use lapply to get the expressed genes of every sender cell type separately here
  list_expressed_genes_sender <- sender_celltypes %>% unique() %>% lapply(get_expressed_genes, merged, 0.05)
  expressed_genes_sender <- list_expressed_genes_sender %>% unlist() %>% unique()

  potential_ligands_focused <- intersect(potential_ligands, expressed_genes_sender) 
  
  #define the geneset of interest
  condition_oi <-  "NF"
  condition_reference <- "SysHF"

  seurat_obj_receiver <- subset(merged, idents = receiver)
  
  #changed min pct to 0.1
  DE_table_receiver <-  FindMarkers(object = seurat_obj_receiver,
                                  ident.1 = condition_oi, ident.2 = condition_reference,
                                  group.by = "condition",
                                  min.pct = 0.1) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  
  #changed logFC to 0.4
  #geneset_oi <- DE_table_receiver %>% filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) >= 0.4) %>% pull(gene)
  #removed abs to focus on condition of interest
  geneset_oi <- DE_table_receiver %>% filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05 & avg_log2FC >= 0.4) %>% pull(gene)
  geneset_oi <- geneset_oi %>% .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
  
  #define the background genes
  background_expressed_genes <- expressed_genes_receiver %>% .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
  
  #perform nichenet ligand activity analysis
  #interest cutoff at auroc of 0.5
  # area under precision recall curve
  
  ligand_activities <- predict_ligand_activities(geneset = geneset_oi,
                                               background_expressed_genes = background_expressed_genes,
                                               ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
                                               potential_ligands = potential_ligands)
  
  #potential ligands focused for the sender focused approach
  ligand_activities <- ligand_activities %>% filter(test_ligand %in% potential_ligands_focused)
  best_upstream_ligands <- ligand_activities %>% top_n(30, aupr_corrected) %>% arrange(-aupr_corrected) %>%
    pull(test_ligand) %>% unique()
  
  active_ligand_target_links_df <- best_upstream_ligands %>%
    lapply(get_weighted_ligand_target_links,
         geneset = geneset_oi,
         ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
         n = 100) %>%
    bind_rows() %>% drop_na()
  
  active_ligand_target_links_df <- active_ligand_target_links_df %>% mutate(receiver = receiver)
  
  return(active_ligand_target_links_df)
}
```

```{r}
results_list <- lapply(receiver_celltypes, nichenet_function)
all_results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
```

#total interactions graph
```{r}
# Create edges data frame and add a self-loop for endocardium
edges <- interaction_counts %>%
  mutate(sender = "endocardium") %>%
  rename(from = sender, to = receiver) %>%
  select(from, to, count)

# Define nodes data frame
nodes <- unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))
nodes_df <- data.frame(name = nodes)

# Create a graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes_df, edges = edges, directed = TRUE)

# Plot using ggraph
ggraph(graph, layout = 'circle') +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(width = count),  # Adds a curved line with weight based on count
                color = color_key['endocardium'],  # Set all arrows to endocardium's color
                arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), 
                end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'),
                curvature = 0.1) +  # Reduced curvature for less intense curves
  geom_node_point(aes(color = name), size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_key) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Endocardium Interactions with Recipient Cell Types") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

#plotting all interactions 

```{r}
#filter out situations where ligands are found in the target column
unique_ligands <- unique(all_results_df$ligand)

filtered_data <- all_results_df[!all_results_df$target %in% unique_ligands, ]
```


```{r}
library(circlize)

# Ensure previous plots are cleared
circos.clear()

# Loop through each receiver cell type
for (cell_type in unique(filtered_data$receiver)) {
  # Filter data for the current cell type
  data_subset <- filtered_data[filtered_data$receiver == cell_type, ]
  
  # Prepare data for the chord diagram
  data_matrix <- data_subset %>%
    select(ligand, target, weight)
  
  # Initialize a new plot for each cell type
  pdf(paste0("Chord_Diagram_", cell_type, ".pdf"), width = 20/2.54, height = 20/2.54)
  
  # Create the chord diagram
  chordDiagram(
    data_matrix,
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    transparency = 0.5,
    directional = 1,  # Enables directionality with arrows
    diffHeight = 0.04,  # Space out chords for better visibility
    link.sort = TRUE,  # Sort links to reduce overlap
    link.lwd = data_subset$weight * 10,  # Scale line width by weight
    link.border = "darkcyan",
    link.arr.type = "big.arrow",  # Use "big arrow" style for direction
    preAllocateTracks = 1  # Pre-allocate space for labels
  )
  
  # Add labels outside and perpendicular to the sectors
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1, 
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      circos.text(
        CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1], 
        CELL_META$sector.index, 
        facing = "clockwise", 
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5)
      )
    }, bg.border = NA
  )
  
  # Add a title for each plot
  title(paste("Chord Diagram for", cell_type))
  
  # Save and close the file
  dev.off()
}

# Clear the circos environment after the loop
circos.clear()
```
